_comment: Targets for fleet_doctor.py. Copy this outside the repo (for example to
$HOME/.hermes/cortex_fleet_targets.json), fill in your real hosts, and pass
it with --targets. Real host names and home paths stay out of git.
Paths may use ~ or $HOME; both are expanded. For a REMOTE target the paths
are resolved on that machine, so ~ there means that user's home.
label   name shown in the report (the agent or profile name)
host    ssh destination; OMIT or null for a profile on this machine
python  interpreter that can import the Cortex plugin on that host
doctor  path to nightly_doctor.py on that host
home    HERMES_HOME for the profile (where its config.yaml lives)
